role: Harmonia's appliance update-set and member release evidence

authority.grant: Operator-elected public seat for the Harmonia update-set

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent optional fields mean no evidence; an unresolved syzygy remains a signal, not failed module convergence

set_verdict.description: ok: the set committed; failed: the press was red and nothing was restored; failed-rolled-back: every held root and service was restored and verified; failed-rollback-incomplete: a restoration was owed and is not whole

wukong_staff_member_sources.description: One row for each member the body declares, keyed by the member's name; null unless the Wukong stamp's verdict is VALID

status.description: standing: the set committed; rolled-back: a member with a held root or service was restored; rollback-incomplete: restoration was not whole; not-restored: a member of a red press that was not restored: nothing of it was held, or the red step was a developer module's and the safe modules kept what they got

Member.description: Member observations retain their existing fields unchanged; source_sha is additive release evidence

MemberSource.description: Source evidence for one member declared by the body

stamp_sha.description: The Wukong stamp's term for the member, a git commit, not a 64-hex Ruyi row stamp

effective_target.description: A fire seal's term for the member over the stamp's

matches.description: Whether source_sha equals the stamp's term stamp_sha alone; null when either is absent

mode.description: The member's place on harmonia.safe_modules: safe follows the Wukong stamp and a seal when on the list; developer is given no pin when off it; this is not the run receipt's mode or source_policy

followed.description: stamp moves the member to the stamp's term; seal moves it to a fire seal's term; newest means no pin in developer mode or because no VALID stamp named the member, taking its own repo's newest flagged Release for a binary or the tip of its configured ref for a source shelf

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
